scalars.scalar_value: High School Graduate or High School GED
Completed and passed Surgical Scrub Technical Training or Obstetrical Technician Training for new hires as of 7/1/2009. 10 years recent OB Tech experience in lieu of formal training is acceptable

items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire (Must be through the American Heart Association)
High School Graduate or High School GED
Completed and passed Surgical Scrub Technical Training or Obstetrical Technician Training for new hires as of 7/1/2009. 10 years recent OB Tech experience in lieu of formal training is acceptable
One (1) year experience as an OB Tech., upon hire
Additional experience in providing care to neonates, children and adolescents. , upon hire

OBSERVATION OF PATIENTS: Continually observe patient needs by making rounds, and discussing patient needs with other staff members and family members. Assist nurses with care of patients. Supply patients with items needed for care of themself and their baby

Assist with maintaining infant security by educating families on security practices of unit, wearing appropriate identification and maintaining awareness of activities and visitors on the unit. Communicate effectively and courteously with the patient/family member, FBC staff, ancillary staff, physicians. Meets job expectations of job standards

Departmental Guidelines Assisting with ambulation and transportation of patients when directed and it is appropriate. Promote the patient's right and need for privacy and maintain confidentiality. Provide emotional support for patients and their families by utilizing communication skills. Seek and accept direction from staff RN, NSM and Nurse Manager. Reporting significant changes in patients' condition to the RN, or Charge nurse immediately.
Participate in quality assurance activities. Make rounds on patients. Sets table for delivery for physicians.

Operating room to be checked for supplies and cleanliness at the beginning of the shift and after each C-Section delivery. Assists in ensuring that Newborn Screening forms are complete, logged in and sent out in a timely manner. Attend deliveries and assist nurse as necessary. Helps with cleanup patients and placing mother back in bed following delivery.

KEEPS FLOOR STOCK SUPPLIES AT PROPER LEVEL. Orders and stocks delivery and other miscellaneous supplies. Maintains par cart. Collaborates with unit staff to determine and order other unit supplies. Stocks and maintains supplies in rooms and on delivery carts. Assists in putting away stock when delivered by Warehouse.
Can scrub, set up and maintain a sterile field and perform the duties of a OB Technologist for surgical procedures in the OB department.
